Title: Category - Sorting Options (API-driven sortings)
Preconditions: Category with multiple products; storefront uses vc-frontend theme 2.52+ which builds sort dropdown from API sortings
Steps:
[NAV] Navigate to a category page on {{FRONT_URL}}
[WAIT] Wait for sort dropdown to render
[ASSERT] Snapshot the sort dropdown — capture all visible option labels (live-discover from DOM; do NOT assume specific label text)
[ASSERT] Verify at least 2 sort options are present
[ASSERT] Identify the price-ascending option by code match (code: price-ascending); note its live label as {price_asc_label}
[ASSERT] Capture first product card ID before sorting → {first_id_default}
[ACT] Click the combobox to open the sort dropdown (VcSelect: click the combobox to open, then click the option by accessible name — do NOT use native select-option)
[ACT] Click the {price_asc_label} option by accessible name
[WAIT] Wait for products to reorder; verify ?sort=price-ascending in URL
[ASSERT] Verify combobox accessible name = {price_asc_label} (selection reflected)
[ASSERT] Capture first product card ID → {first_id_asc}
[ACT] Click the combobox and select the price-descending option (code: price-descending) by its live label
[WAIT] Wait for products to reorder; verify ?sort=price-descending in URL
[ASSERT] Verify combobox accessible name = price-descending label
[ASSERT] Capture first product card ID → {first_id_desc}
[ASSERT] Verify {first_id_asc} != {first_id_desc} (ascending and descending produce different first items — server-authoritative direction oracle; do NOT assert monotonic price order — indexed price diverges from pack/variation-resolved price.actual)
[ACT] Scroll to the bottom of the product grid to trigger infinite-scroll load-more (storefront uses infinite scroll on category pages — no numbered pager)
[WAIT] Wait for the next batch to append
[ASSERT] Verify combobox accessible name still = price-descending label after scroll-load (sort persists)
[ASSERT] Verify URL still contains ?sort=price-descending after scroll (no ?page param)
Assertions:
[DOM] Sort dropdown combobox visible with options sourced from API sortings (at least 2 options; no hardcoded label assumptions)
[STATE] Combobox accessible name reflects the selected option after each selection
[STATE] {first_id_asc} != {first_id_desc} — sort direction has observable effect on result order (server-authoritative oracle; no monotonic-price assertion)
[STATE] Sort combobox accessible name persists after infinite-scroll load-more
[NAV] URL contains ?sort=<code> for non-default selections; no ?page param (infinite scroll)
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[NETWORK] no 4xx/5xx on sort change request
[NETWORK] POST /graphql (products) includes sort parameter in request; scroll fires continuation with same sort code
[CONSOLE] no TypeError or JS errors
Failure_Signals: Sort dropdown combobox not rendering; native select-option failing on VcSelect; combobox accessible name not updating on selection; {first_id_asc} == {first_id_desc} (sort direction not applied); combobox name resetting after infinite-scroll load-more; console TypeError
References: VCST-5177; regression-qa-theme-26.csv; Synced: VCST-5177 (2026-06-26); Corrected: VcSelect combobox + infinite-scroll + no-monotonic-price oracle (2026-06-26)
